Definition: to wrap, i.e. cover, veil, cloth, or roll
BiblicalUsage: 1) to cover, enwrap, wrap oneself, envelop oneself; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to wrap, envelop oneself; 1a2) to cover (the beard in mourning); 1a3) mourner, one who covers (participle); 1b) (Hiphil) to cover, enwrap, envelop; 2) to grasp; 2a) (Qal) to grasp
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
